h1: Tax handling and currencies for your subscriptions
overview: Selling to customers in other places raises two questions: which currency do they pay in, and is tax added. We set up your payment provider's tax tools, such as Stripe Tax, with the product types and locations you tell us. We add the right currencies, show prices in a customer's own currency where it helps, and collect tax IDs from business buyers. We are not tax advisers, so your accountant confirms the rules.

faq: Do you tell me where I have to register for tax?
No. Where you must register and collect is a question for your accountant or tax adviser. We set the provider's tools to follow the rules you give us.
Stripe Tax and Paddle, which acts as a merchant of record, both help. Their costs and coverage differ. We explain the trade-offs so you can choose before we configure anything.
Will prices change when exchange rates move?
Not unless you want that. We set fixed local prices by default, so a customer sees the same number each time. Automatic conversion is possible if you prefer it.
Yes. Adding a currency is a small task that we can repeat for each new one, and we leave notes showing what is needed on your provider's side.
